// One-hot encoded Mealy finite-state machine.
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  x,
    output reg z
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin z=1'b0; if (x) next_state=2'b01; else next_state=2'b00; end
            2'b01: begin z=1'b1; if (x) next_state=2'b10; else next_state=2'b01; end
            2'b10: begin z=1'b0; if (x) next_state=2'b11; else next_state=2'b10; end
            2'b11: begin z=1'b1; if (x) next_state=2'b01; else next_state=2'b11; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
endmodule
